sources.title: toryo: packages/cli/src/index.ts
sources.locator: command dispatch, runCommand, dashboardCommand, init and export commands
sources.finding: The CLI initializes specs/configuration, checks locally installed adapters, runs cycles, prints metrics/history and exports reports. It launches the dashboard as a separate Node process.

sources.title: toryo: packages/adapters/src/index.ts
sources.locator: createAdapter factory; sibling base.ts, claude-code.ts, codex.ts, cursor.ts, cline.ts, aider.ts, gemini-cli.ts, ollama.ts and custom.ts
sources.finding: CLI adapters spawn installed executables and inherit the host environment; Ollama calls its configured HTTP endpoint. The factory lists Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, Aider, Gemini and Ollama; CustomAdapter is an SDK class rather than a factory branch.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/orchestrator.ts
sources.locator: createOrchestrator; sendToAgent; runPhase; runCycleInternal; run; stop
sources.finding: Configured phase agents run via adapters; within-phase parallel assignment uses Promise.all. Cycles serialize, phases forward output/context, the last phase reviews captured evidence, and retry/metrics/knowledge writes follow acceptance. stop signals graceful shutdown rather than immediate child termination.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/specs.ts
sources.locator: loadSpecs, parseSpec, defaultPhases and parseAcceptanceCriteria; types.ts TaskSpec
sources.finding: Markdown/YAML specs have filename IDs, acceptance criteria, phases, tags and difficulty. This schema has no epic/dependency/issue-state/owner fields.

sources.title: toryo: packages/dashboard/src/server.ts
sources.finding: Browser dashboard reads metrics/results, watches local output files and exposes spec CRUD. WebSocket handles ping only; routes do not expose live agent prompting or authentication/roles.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/delegation.ts
sources.finding: Deterministic phase/strength/trust selection assigns agents. Supervised/guided/autonomous levels add prompt instructions; they are not permission or sandbox enforcement.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/knowledge.ts
sources.locator: createKnowledgeStore, set, search, clear and toContext
sources.finding: Local knowledge.json holds source/timestamp/tagged entries, replaces keys and evicts older entries at a default 200 entries. Context is injected by the orchestrator; no background freshness or provenance verification exists.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/context.ts
sources.finding: Scans matching local files, skips each above64KiB and budgets included file-content UTF-16 length. Complete file tree/path/header overhead is additional and not globally capped. Orchestrator gathers once at run start.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/ratchet.ts
sources.locator: beginAttempt, commit, accept, revert, shouldKeep and lock ownership checks
sources.finding: Git attempts use an exclusive common-directory lock and require a clean repository root. Checkpoints retain exact base/head/branch identity; accept and revert refuse changed work. Revert makes a new commit, preserving history.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/review-evidence.ts
sources.locator: captureReviewEvidence; sibling review.ts parseReview; orchestrator reviewAttempt
sources.finding: Trusted required-check commands run sequentially with bounded time/output. Captured patch/check SHA-256 IDs must all occur exactly once in strict reviewer JSON; invalid/missing evidence or failing checks prevents acceptance. Records retain raw review and evidence on disk.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/metrics.ts
sources.finding: Metrics persist locally as JSON and per-cycle results as TSV; named agents, scores and verdicts are recorded. No model/token/compute billing fields exist.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/notifications.ts
sources.finding: Optional ntfy, Slack, Discord or custom webhooks send selected cycle/review notifications with a ten-second network timeout. Default is no notification provider. These are user-directed delivery, not vendor telemetry.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/bus/bus.ts
sources.finding: Public SDK provides in-process task IDs, messages, event streams, cancellation and result maps. It does not connect external agent CLI processes to this bus or persist bus state.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/extraction.ts
sources.finding: Code blocks, skill blocks and large outputs are written under the local output directory. Review JSON is separately retained by the orchestrator; no media capture or artifact gallery is implemented.

sources.title: toryo: packages/core/src/config.ts
sources.finding: Configuration supplies adapters/models/timeouts, tasks, ratchet checks/retries and delegation. It does not supply accounts, teams, remote provisioning, calendars, compute limits or pricing.
